purpose_overview: Agent Zero is a personal, organic agentic framework that grows and learns with you. It provides a fully-customizable, transparent, and interactive AI agent system that uses the operating system as a tool.
key_features: Real-time streaming with interactive web UI
getting_started:
1. Clone the repository
2. Configure your LLM provider in settings
3. Run with Docker or directly via Python
4. Access the web UI at http://localhost:80

components.name: Agent Core
components.purpose: Central agent logic managing message loops and tool invocation
components.functionality: Processes user messages, orchestrates tools, manages context
components.technical_details: Implemented in agent.py with AgentContext and Agent classes

components.name: Memory System
components.functionality: Stores, searches, and recalls information using vector embeddings
components.technical_details: Uses embedding models for semantic similarity search

components.name: Skills System
components.purpose: Extensible capability modules using SKILL.md standard
components.functionality: Loads, searches, and executes contextually relevant skills
components.technical_details: Skills are indexed in vector memory for semantic recall

components.name: Tools System
components.purpose: Agent interaction capabilities with external systems
components.functionality: Code execution, web search, browser automation, file operations

components.name: Extensions Framework
components.functionality: 26+ extension points for modifying agent behavior at various stages
components.technical_details: Python extensions loaded from extensions/ directory

core.name: Conversation Processing
core.description: Handles user messages through the agent message loop

core.name: Code Execution
core.description: Sandboxed execution of Python, Node.js, and shell scripts

core.name: Memory Management
core.description: Persistent storage and semantic recall of information

technical.specifications: Python 3.10+, LiteLLM for multi-provider LLM support, Docker for containerization
technical.api_reference: 40+ API endpoints for chat, settings, memory, skills, and project management
technical.implementation: Core agent loop in agent.py, model abstraction in models.py, tool system in python/tools/

user_guide.installation:
1. Clone repository
2. Copy .env.example to .env
3. Configure API keys
4. Run: docker compose up
user_guide.basic_usage:
1. Open web UI
2. Type messages in chat
3. Agent processes and responds
4. Use skills and tools as needed
user_guide.troubleshooting:
- Check API keys in .env
- Verify Docker is running
- Check logs/ for error details

glossary.Agent: An AI entity that processes messages and executes tools
glossary.Subordinate: A child agent delegated to handle specific tasks
glossary.SKILL.md: Standard format for defining agent capabilities
glossary.Memory Fragment: A piece of stored information with vector embedding

faq.question: How do I add a new skill?
faq.answer: Create a directory under skills/custom/ with a SKILL.md file following the standard format.

faq.question: Can I use multiple LLM providers?
faq.answer: Yes, Agent Zero supports 20+ providers through LiteLLM integration.
